name: Sacheta Metals Limited
about: Sacheta Metals Limited manufactures and exports aluminum, stainless, and mild steel houseware kitchenware utensils in India and internationally. The company offers nonstick cookware pressure cookers, foil chaquered sheets, PP caps/slugs, and other houseware products; castings, sheets, coils, and circles; and stainless-steel kitchenware products. It also provides topes with cover and HDL; kettles and milk cans; screw barnis and milk jugs; kadais; saucepans; basrawi bowls and moglai katoras; laddle and zaras; mugs, vagarias, lemon juicers, and aluminum bags; pawalis, square dabbas, stock pots 83, and tubs; nonsticks; cups; tiffins; glasses; fry pans with aluminum HDL; sauce pots; basri tops; caseroles; degadas and rice stainers; charvis, kathalis, and khaldastas; aluminum housefoils; bucket kavadanis; basrai lotas and date bowls; badanas and chilamchis; butter pots; dabbas; tawas; plates/khumchas; oval and square trays; and oven dishes and basins 74. The company was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Mumbai, India.
